# RayMeshes

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/renderer/lighting/ray_meshes.h`](../../../src/renderer/lighting/ray_meshes.h) · Described in `data/passes.json`

The meshes, volume boxes and textures the passes give to the rays (ray tracing only).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `meshes` | `std::vector<RayMesh>` | Meshes to trace: kind (Terrain, Solid, Plant, Volume), vertex and index buffers, vertex stride, first vertex, vertex count, parts (first index, index count, opaque, texture, alpha cutoff, colour, transmission). |
| `boxes` | `std::vector<RayBox>` | Boxes of the baked plant volumes: volume index (bindings 10 to 12), min, size, voxel. |
| `textures` | `std::vector<vk::DescriptorImageInfo>` | Textures the rays test leaves against (view set binding 6), at most max_textures (512). |

## Notes

Emplaced by RayScene's constructor, erased by its destructor. add(RayMesh) and add(RayBox) return stable indices (nothing is taken back); texture(view, sampler) returns the index of a texture, -1 past 512. Added to by VegetationPass, ModelPass, PlantVolumes; read by RayScene. Main thread only.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: PlantVolumes, RayScene, model, vegetation. Created by: RayScene. Destroyed by: RayScene.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [PlantVolumes](../systems/service-PlantVolumes.md) | service | Host | **readwrite** | start, finish | Parts of the species' mesh read; the volume's RayBox added. |
| [RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md) | service | Host | **readwrite+create+destroy** | constructor, updateMeshes, gatherInstances, destructor | Emplaced and erased here; meshes, boxes and textures read once the passes added them. |
| [model](../systems/pass-model.md) | pass | Host | **readwrite** | update | Adds each model's mesh to the rays (ray tracing). |
| [vegetation](../systems/pass-vegetation.md) | pass | Host | **readwrite** | constructor, finishJob | Adds each species' traced mesh and its leaf textures (ray tracing). |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[PlantVolumes](../systems/service-PlantVolumes.md)**
  - Allocates three 3D images per baked species; records bake dispatches and mip blits into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Writes Context::plant_volumes (view set bindings 10 to 12).
  - Logs an info line per volume baked.
- **[RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md)**
  - Builds and refits acceleration structures in the frame's compute command buffer; allocates their buffers, scratch, geometry table and instance buffers.
  - Writes Context::tlas, ray_geometries and ray_textures, which every view set gets.
  - Connects onChunkGone to on_destroy<ChunkTriangles>; the destructor disconnects it and waits for the device.
- **[model](../systems/pass-model.md)**
  - Allocates a descriptor set per material and an image view per texture.
  - Records the indexed draws of every model part into both targets.
- **[vegetation](../systems/pass-vegetation.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers (silent_async, 6 at a time); uploads buffers and textures, allocates descriptor sets.
  - Logs each species loaded, errors for species and textures that fail.
  - With ray tracing gives meshes and textures to the rays (RayMeshes).
  - Records the plant draws and the far volume boxes of both targets; the destructor waits for running jobs.
